title: A-160 assembly & design review
registerRevision: 2026-09-10 · Physical equipment ownership and complete Explore assemblies
lead: Pre-G fixing, filtration and drying: fixing tank T-161, holding tank T-162, membrane filter press F-161 with wet-cake tray handling TR-164, vacuum tray dryer D-164 with vacuum / condensate package VP-164 / KO-164 and dry tray unloading H-164, dry Pre-G distribution EL-164 / SC-164, filtrate tank T-163 and the four register pumps P-162 … P-165 (baseline A-160 configuration).

findings.topic: Dilution basis — Option B now, Option C later
findings.reason: The fixing-water quantity decides tank size, cooling, settle / decant practice and the wastewater load; the PFD figure is a heat sink, not a process requirement.
findings.observation: D-A160-02 approves the REP-042 concept — Option B now, designed so that its filter and rinse become Option C when REP-039 M4 confirms GIC filterability — and D-A160-01 withdraws the MEB-004 V5 sizing on 50 kg/h graphite and 170 kg water per kg graphite (T-161 49.2 m³; REP-042 shows ≈ 2 × 110 m³ HDPE as drawn and recommends 10–15 t per batch, about 20–30 kg/kg), the 28 kW dilution cooling (REP-042: 6.2 GJ per batch dilution heat), the settle / decant hours (pilot 3 × 3.5 h do not transfer — Stokes settling scales with depth; decant is dilution washing), the T-162 wash water and the D-164 duty. Feed now arrives at 80 °C by hot transfer (D-A140-02); no jacket on a 110 m³ HDPE tank — protect the addition point against local boiling.
findings.action: Decide the A-160 dilution basis (Option B with the Option C path), re-issue FEED-PE-MEB-004 (V6) on DBM V2.0, then fix T-161 / T-162 size and cooling, and confirm water inlet ≤ 28 °C keeps T-161 below 50 °C.

findings.reason: The press cycle and cake moisture set the dryer duty and the tray handling rate.
findings.observation: D-A160-02 approves F-161 as correctly sized and cake-volume-limited (REP-042 F-10, GREEN): 3 wash / press cycles, 6 h cycle, cake 0.57 m³ per batch, displacement wash ≈ 2 m³; cake moisture 50 wt% (MEB-004) — REP-042 states ≈ 80 wt% solids after press, a difference carried to the follow-up. F-161 is PP plates and cloth with protected frame (MAT-002). Wet-cake tray handling TR-164 and the register pumps P-164 (slurry to press) and P-165 (filtrate wastewater) have model geometry; P-162 … P-165 have no semantic record.
findings.action: Reconcile the 50 wt% moisture (MEB-004) with the ≈ 80 wt% solids (REP-042) in MEB-004 V6; create semantic records for P-162 … P-165.

findings.topic: Drying — vacuum tray dryer as modelled, Option E open
findings.status: Targets approved — dryer type follows Option E
findings.reason: The dryer type and duty follow the cake solids and the REP-042 Option E alternative.
findings.observation: Approved (D-A160-02, MEB-004): 60 °C drying temperature target and 2 wt% residual moisture; D-164 316L electropolished (MAT-002). The 47.3 kW duty on 50 kg/h is withdrawn and REP-042 Option E changes the dryer. The model carries the vacuum tray dryer with its vacuum / condensate package VP-164 / KO-164, dry tray unloading H-164 and the dry Pre-G distribution EL-164 / SC-164 (4,586 parts) — none of these auxiliaries is on LST-001, and the D-164-THERMAL subassembly is provisional.
findings.action: Decide Option E with the dilution basis; then size D-164 (or its replacement) on MEB-004 V6 and register VP-164 / KO-164, H-164, TR-164 and EL-164 / SC-164 or record them by decision.

findings.status: Ruled — six items not yet covered
findings.reason: Dilute sulphuric / persulfate liquor at up to 80 °C sets the tank and pump materials; the press and dryer see wet and dry Pre-G.
findings.observation: D-A160-MOC applies MAT-002: T-161 dual-laminate FRP (PVDF / ECTFE liner + VE-novolac) to ASME RTP-1; F-161 PP plates and cloth; D-164 316L electropolished; MDL-001 (glass-lined CS, PP plates) superseded. MAT-002 does not cover T-162, T-163 and the four pumps P-162 … P-165, which keep an MDL-001 material only. REP-042 speaks of 110 m³ HDPE tanks as drawn — the tank material and the dilution option are linked.
findings.action: Extend MAT-002 to T-162, T-163 and P-162 … P-165 once the dilution option fixes tank size and temperature.

findings.topic: Register and model reconciliation, containment and interfaces
findings.reason: Every equipment item in the area must have one identity in the register, the model and the data layer; wastewater and decant interfaces need destinations.
findings.observation: Five LST-001 tags (T-161, T-162, F-161, D-164, T-163) are bound to model geometry; the four register pumps have geometry but no semantic record; the model additionally owns TR-164, H-164, EL-164 / SC-164 and VP-164 / KO-164 without register identities, four bunds (16.4 / 16.4 / 10.4 / 11.5 m³ retention), two emergency stations and fire point FE-161. Three interfaces — fixing wastewater WW161, filtrate wastewater WW163 and decant DEC161 — have no destination in A-1000.
findings.action: Register the model-only auxiliaries or record them by decision; create the pump records; assign the WW161 / WW163 / DEC161 destinations with the A-1000 discharge decision (D-A1000-01); verify bund retention for the hot-transfer case.

decisions.rationale: Plant-wide ruling: FEED-PE-MAT-002 'Recommended MOC (base case)' governs material of construction over FEED-PE-MDL-001 (scale-up study) and design-note wording — MAT-002 is the controlled MoC matrix and postdates MDL-001. Wording variants of the same material family are superseded by the MAT-002 statement.
decisions.gapNote: MAT-002 does not cover 6 item(s) with an MDL-001 material only (P-162, P-163, P-164, P-165, T-162, T-163): extend MAT-002 before those MoCs are approved.

decisions.rationale: MEB-004 V5 sizes T-161 on 50 kg/h graphite and 170 kg water per kg graphite; REP-042 shows the water is a heat sink and recommends Option B (about 10–15 t per batch). No size approved.
